entities.summary: Alan Lee is an English book illustrator and film conceptual designer. He is best known for his artwork inspired by J. R. Tolkien's fantasy novels, and for his work on the concept design of Peter Jackson's film adaptations of Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings and The Hobbit film series.
